Kimi K3.1 Pro has launched with a 1-million-token context on Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the API. It's the first K3.1-series model, and open weights are promised after the hosted release. BenchCAD's 92.7 percent result includes tool use, so teams should separate planner decisions, tool calls, and execution steps from raw model output. #AI #MachineLearning #SoftwareEngineering #Technology
